name: Wapusk National Park
policyReason: The park's own visitor and safety pages say nothing about dogs, so this rests on the National Parks of Canada Domestic Animals Regulations (SOR/98-177) and Parks Canada's dog page: dogs on a 3 m leash, with no area of this park posted as closed.
summary: No dog rules of its own; the national rule applies: dogs on a leash of 3 m or less, under control at all times.

(b) in respect of a domestic animal to which paragraph (a) does not apply, restraint by a leash that does not exceed 3 metres in length; or
When visiting a Parks Canada place dogs must be on a leash and under control at all times.

dogRules.text: Dogs must be under physical control (a leash of 3 m or less) at all times.
Dogs may not chase or disturb wildlife, or enter areas posted as closed to domestic animals.
Keeping a dog in the park more than 30 days a year needs a permit.
The park's visitor pages name no dog rules or closures.
